description: Find open times for a visit of a given length. Looks inside shop hours (or Monday to Friday 08:00 to 17:00 when none are set), skips worker time off and times outside a worker's own hours, and keeps the shop's travel buffer clear around booked visits. Give person_ids or a saved crew_id (or both) to check those workers (together: all of them free at once, the default; or any one of them). Leave it out to check every worker in the shop and get back who is free. Field workers can only check themselves. Nothing is booked; call visits.create with a slot.

to.description: Latest end. Default 14 days after from; at most 31 days after it.

name: schedule_findTime

arrive_by.description: End of the arrival window to tell the customer.
